headline: This law extends for five more years a federal program that pays children's hospitals that train doctors in residency programs.
what_it_does: The law amends the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize a program that makes payments to children's hospitals that run graduate medical education programs. Graduate medical education is the hands-on training doctors complete after medical school. The extension runs through fiscal year 2023. The official summary does not give details on payment amounts or formulas.

who_it_affects.group: Children's hospitals that operate graduate medical education programs
who_it_affects.how: They can keep receiving federal payments to support their doctor-training programs through fiscal year 2023.

who_it_affects.group: Medical residents training at children's hospitals
who_it_affects.how: Their training programs at these hospitals continue to receive federal support through fiscal year 2023.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 18, 2018, with the reauthorized program running through fiscal year 2023.
